```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(stringr)
```

Set folder directory, import and trim files
```{r}
in_dir  <- "raw_data/HOBO_loggerdat"
out_dir <- "processed_data"
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
 
files <- list.files(in_dir, pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)
if (length(files) == 0) stop("No .csv files found in ", in_dir)
 
read_logger_file <- function(path) {
  # pond_field_id and sensor_location come from the file name,
  # e.g. Thaw_Pond_A_Bottom_aug.csv -> A, Bottom
  m <- str_match(basename(path), "Pond_([A-Z])_(Bottom|Surface)")
  if (any(is.na(m))) stop("File name does not match expected pattern: ", basename(path))
 
  # Line 1 = plot title, line 2 = header; data starts on line 3.
  # Columns: 2 = date/time, 3 = temperature (the header names contain logger
  # serial numbers, so select by position instead of by name).
  raw <- read_csv(
    path,
    skip = 2, col_names = FALSE, col_select = c(2, 3),
    col_types = cols(.default = col_character()),
    progress = FALSE
  )
  names(raw) <- c("datetime_raw", "temp_raw")
 
  dat <- raw %>%
    mutate(
      # kept in logger local time as recorded (tz label "UTC" only avoids DST shifts)
      datetime = parse_date_time(datetime_raw, orders = "mdy IMS p", tz = "UTC"),
      temp     = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(temp_raw))
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(temp))   # drops logger event rows (coupler, host connected, stopped, etc.)
 
  if (anyNA(dat$datetime)) warning("Unparsed datetimes in ", basename(path))
 
  # Cut first and last hour of valid data
  t_start <- min(dat$datetime)
  t_end   <- max(dat$datetime)
  dat <- dat %>%
    filter(datetime >= t_start + hours(1), datetime <= t_end - hours(1))
 
  dat %>%
    transmute(
      pond_field_id   = m[2],
      sensor_location = m[3],
      datetime,
      temp
    )
}
```

 Combine all files
```{r}
all_data <- bind_rows(lapply(files, read_logger_file)) %>%
  arrange(pond_field_id, sensor_location, datetime)
 
write_csv(all_data, file.path(out_dir, "pond_temperature_2018-19_all.csv"))

```

Daily mean by pond, combining Surface and Bottom sensors
```{r}
daily <- all_data %>%
  mutate(date = as_date(datetime)) %>%
  group_by(pond_field_id, date) %>%
  summarise(
    temp_avg = round(mean(temp), 1),
    temp_sd  = round(sd(temp), 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
 
write_csv(daily, file.path(out_dir, "pond_temperature_2018-19_daily.csv"))
```
